name: AppImages
author: Paul Olthof
description: Drop an AppImage in a folder and it shows up in your bar, with the name and icon it ships with -- read out of the image without running it. Allow it to run once and it gets a launcher entry; rename, hide or delete it from the bar. Nothing is made executable or run without your say-so.

barWidget.description: Lists the AppImages in your folder, with inline rename and a manual sync.
